---
title: "Behavioral signatures of the computational subtypes"
output: html_document
date: "2025-11-12"
---

Model-free behavioral signatures of the four computational subtypes. The k-means
solution from cluster_analysis.Rmd is reconstructed (same seed and labeling), then
three behavioral measures are computed per participant from the pooled Study 1B +
2B data: overall justice rating, injustice-severity sensitivity (slope of ratings
on severity), and delay sensitivity (slope of ratings on log-transformed delay).

Output map:
- Kruskal-Wallis H / eta^2 on the three measures -> printed below
- Figure 3B (behavioral signatures)              -> Figure3B_behavioral.png

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries-and-theme}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggplot2, rstatix, patchwork)

rootdir         <- "D:/DJ/JEPG/Cluster_Analysis"
data_savedir    <- paste0(rootdir, "/data/")
stanfit_savedir <- paste0(rootdir, "/output/stanfits/")
plot_savedir    <- paste0(rootdir, "/output/figures/")
if (!dir.exists(plot_savedir)) dir.create(plot_savedir, recursive = TRUE)

subtype_levels <- c("B", "E", "C", "D")
subtype_colors <- c("B" = "#A1D99B", "E" = "#74C476", "C" = "#238B45", "D" = "#00441B")
subtype_name   <- c("B" = "Balanced observers",
                    "E" = "Equity-preferred evaluators",
                    "C" = "Compensatory moralists",
                    "D" = "Delay-averse evaluators")
subtype_color_scale <- scale_color_manual(values = subtype_colors, name = "Subtype",
                                           labels = subtype_name, guide = "none")
type_labels <- c(help = "Compensation", punish = "Punishment")

theme_nature <- function(base_size = 16, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
          axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 8)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 8)),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm"))
}
theme_set(theme_nature())
```

# 1. Reconstruct the four subtypes

```{r clustering}
target_pars <- c("gamma_help", "gamma_punish", "k_help", "k_punish")

df_wide <- read_csv(paste0(stanfit_savedir, "winmodel_DJ_all_rescale_m1-4_indpm.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(pars_name %in% target_pars) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pars_name, values_from = pars_value) %>%
  na.omit()

param_matrix <- scale(df_wide[, target_pars])
set.seed(123)
km_res <- kmeans(param_matrix, centers = 4, nstart = 25)
df_wide$cluster <- as.factor(km_res$cluster)

# Same centroid-based labeling as cluster_analysis.Rmd
ctr  <- as.data.frame(km_res$centers)
id_D <- which.max(rowMeans(ctr[, c("k_help", "k_punish")]))
rem  <- setdiff(1:4, id_D)
id_E <- rem[which.max(rowMeans(ctr[rem, c("gamma_help", "gamma_punish")]))]
rem  <- setdiff(rem, id_E)
id_C <- rem[which.max(abs(ctr$gamma_help - ctr$gamma_punish)[rem])]
id_B <- setdiff(rem, id_C)
cluster_code <- setNames(c("B", "E", "C", "D"), as.character(c(id_B, id_E, id_C, id_D)))
df_wide$subtype <- factor(cluster_code[as.character(df_wide$cluster)], levels = subtype_levels)
df_wide$subtype_label <- factor(subtype_name[as.character(df_wide$subtype)],
                                levels = subtype_name[subtype_levels])

print(table(df_wide$subtype))
```

# 2. Load behavior and attach subtype labels

```{r merge-data}
df_beh_clust <- read_csv(paste0(data_savedir, "DJ_all_data4stan.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(df_wide %>% dplyr::select(SbjIdx, subtype, subtype_label), by = c("participant" = "SbjIdx")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subtype)) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("help", "punish")), log_delay = log(delay + 0.5))

cat("Participants:", length(unique(df_beh_clust$participant)),
    "  Trials:", nrow(df_beh_clust), "\n")
```

# 3. Per-participant behavioral measures (pooled across conditions)

```{r measures-pooled}
# Overall justice rating
rating_pool <- df_beh_clust %>%
  group_by(subtype, participant) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(q4, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Injustice-severity sensitivity: slope of condition-mean rating on severity
sev_pool <- df_beh_clust %>%
  group_by(subtype, participant, Inequality) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(q4, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subtype, participant) %>%
  summarise(value = coef(lm(m ~ Inequality))[2], .groups = "drop")

# Delay sensitivity: slope of condition-mean rating on log-transformed delay
delay_pool <- df_beh_clust %>%
  group_by(subtype, participant, log_delay) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(q4, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subtype, participant) %>%
  summarise(value = coef(lm(m ~ log_delay))[2], .groups = "drop")
```

# 4. Kruskal-Wallis tests across subtypes (H, eta^2)

```{r kruskal-wallis}
kw_report <- function(d, measure) {
  kt <- kruskal_test(d, value ~ subtype)
  es <- kruskal_effsize(d, value ~ subtype)
  data.frame(measure = measure, H = round(kt$statistic, 2), df = kt$df,
             p = signif(kt$p, 3), eta2 = round(es$effsize, 2))
}

bind_rows(
  kw_report(rating_pool, "Overall justice rating"),
  kw_report(delay_pool,  "Delay sensitivity"),
  kw_report(sev_pool,    "Injustice-severity sensitivity")
)

# Subtype medians referenced in the main text
cat("\nMedian overall rating by subtype:\n")
print(rating_pool %>% group_by(subtype) %>% summarise(Mdn = round(median(value), 2)))
cat("\nMedian delay sensitivity by subtype:\n")
print(delay_pool %>% group_by(subtype) %>% summarise(Mdn = round(median(value), 2)))
cat("\nMedian injustice-severity sensitivity by subtype:\n")
print(sev_pool %>% group_by(subtype) %>% summarise(Mdn = round(median(value), 2)))
```

# 5. Figure 3B: behavioral signatures (mean +/- SE, by condition)

```{r figure-3B}
# Same three measures computed separately within compensation / punishment
subj_rating <- df_beh_clust %>%
  group_by(subtype, subtype_label, participant, type) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(q4, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "Mean justice rating")

subj_sev <- df_beh_clust %>%
  group_by(subtype, subtype_label, participant, type, Inequality) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(q4, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subtype, subtype_label, participant, type) %>%
  summarise(value = coef(lm(m ~ Inequality))[2], .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "Injustice-severity sensitivity")

subj_delay <- df_beh_clust %>%
  group_by(subtype, subtype_label, participant, type, log_delay) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(q4, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subtype, subtype_label, participant, type) %>%
  summarise(value = coef(lm(m ~ log_delay))[2], .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "Delay sensitivity")

df_profile <- bind_rows(subj_rating, subj_sev, subj_delay) %>%
  group_by(subtype, subtype_label, type, metric) %>%
  summarise(M = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), SE = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Mean justice rating",
                                            "Injustice-severity sensitivity",
                                            "Delay sensitivity")))

# Significant pairs from Dunn post-hoc (Bonferroni-corrected p < .05)
# x positions: B=1, E=2, C=3, D=4 (matching subtype_levels order)
sig_pairs <- list(
  "Mean justice rating" = data.frame(
    x1 = c(1, 2, 2), x2 = c(2, 3, 4), label = c("***", "***", "****")
  ),
  "Injustice-severity sensitivity" = data.frame(
    x1 = c(1, 2, 2), x2 = c(2, 3, 4), label = c("****", "****", "****")
  ),
  "Delay sensitivity" = data.frame(
    x1 = c(3, 1, 2), x2 = c(4, 3, 4), label = c("****", "***", "***")
  )
)

make_panel <- function(metric_label) {
  d <- filter(df_profile, metric == metric_label)

  y_top   <- max(d$M + d$SE, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_bot   <- min(d$M - d$SE, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_top - y_bot
  step    <- y_range * 0.07

  pairs <- sig_pairs[[metric_label]]
  pairs$span <- pairs$x2 - pairs$x1
  pairs <- pairs[order(pairs$span, pairs$x1), ]
  pairs$y_bar <- y_top + step * seq_len(nrow(pairs))

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = subtype, y = M, color = subtype, shape = type)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = M - SE, ymax = M + SE), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.9,
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    subtype_color_scale +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(help = 16, punish = 17),
                       labels = c(help = "Compensation", punish = "Punishment"),
                       name = "Justice Mode") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = subtype_name) +
    labs(x = "Subtype", y = metric_label) +
    theme_nature() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  # for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
  #   yb <- pairs$y_bar[i]
  #   p <- p +
  #     annotate("segment", x = pairs$x1[i], xend = pairs$x2[i],
  #              y = yb, yend = yb, linewidth = 1.1, color = "black")
  # }

  # p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_bot - y_range * 0.05,
  #                               max(pairs$y_bar) + step * 0.6))
  p
}

p_profile <- make_panel("Mean justice rating") +
             make_panel("Injustice-severity sensitivity") +
             make_panel("Delay sensitivity") +
             plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect")

ggsave(file.path(plot_savedir, "Figure3B_behavioral.png"),
       p_profile, width = 15, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
